newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamatane Sec denies bond redemption report.
newsitem.headline: Yamatane Sec denies bond redemption report.

text.p: Yamatane Securities Co Ltd denied a Japanese newspaper report on Wednesday which said the ailing brokerage had secured help in redeeming 20 billion yen worth of convertible bonds (CBs).

Business daily Nikkan Kogyo Shimbun said in its Wednesday edition that a trading house in the Yamatane group would continue to support Yamatane Securities, paving the way for the securities house to redeem its CBs.
"It is not true that we have already found ways for the redemption of CBs which have a value of 20 billion yen," a Yamatane Securities spokesman said.
The prospect of having to pay holders of the CBs has made it difficult for the ailing brokerage to proceed with its restructuring, the paper said.

But the assistance of a group firm had removed that as an obstacle in the brokerage's restructuring and would allow banks which have close business ties with Yamatane to devise a plan to financially support the brokerage, it said.
